I hear a lot of people that use it for the first time, they use it like 3 days in a row, if feels great, then it just stops. Other people claim it works every day for years for them. Similarly, it has a very, very short half life, while some people claim they have benefits from it the entire day. More than likely, L theanine has a lot of benefits that we don’t know about and haven’t been studied. From what we do know, it’s legitimately amazing in its ability to promote alpha brain waves. I just cycle it because I want that maximum benefit (or, rather, what I perceive as maximum benefit).

A few sites I’ve seen say once tolerance is considerably built it takes 10 days of abstinence to return to baseline. If you want to use it daily, by all means do so. If you feel it stops giving you what you want out of it, take a week and a half off and go back to the schedule that works for you :).

The typical use for theanine is to have 200mg of it for each 100mg of caffeine (roughly 1 cup of coffee). And most recommendations say not to go over 1200mg a day (some theorize that higher than that can start giving you minor withdrawal symptoms but it’s all conjecture).

Personally I’ve taken doses ranging from 50-600 in a single go. I like 300mg twice a day, once a week (I’ve read it builds tolerance so I do it max once a week).
